title: Render the institutional sign-in page
preconditions: The local app is running and the doctor check passes.

steps.expected: The page shows the sign-in heading, the @psgitech.ac.in requirement, and one Google action.

steps.action: Open /login?callbackUrl=/questions and inspect the action without activating it.
steps.expected: The page still renders normally and the Google action is present; the callback value is preserved in the URL.

risk: Do not activate the Google action: it leaves the local app and cannot complete with placeholder client values.
